name: Bulgarian Split Squat
common_faults: rear foot too high on bench

substitutions.note: no rear-foot elevation; lower stability demand
dynamic; less time under tension per leg

contraindications: hip flexor injury provoked by rear-foot elevation
knee pain during deep unilateral knee flexion
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom of the split stance; high stretch on rear hip flexor

provenance.notes: Unilateral demand exposes asymmetries. High local quad and glute fatigue relative to systemic load. SFR heuristic.
